## Purpose and scope {#sec-overview}

### Intended users

This manual is for clinicians and reviewers operating the local review workstation, dataset operators preparing research exports, and hospital operators supporting the workstation and Model API.

### Supported input intent

The workstation supports JPEG, PNG, TIFF, and supported single-frame ophthalmic fundus DICOM. Ophthalmic DICOM uses the existing display and provenance path. MRI, OCT, PACS objects, non-fundus DICOM, unsupported SOP classes, multi-frame objects, and untested transfer syntaxes are outside model support.

When a recognized DICOM object is not a supported fundus modality, Worklist reports **Unsupported modality**. This is distinct from a generic decoder or image-read failure.

### System overview

The review workstation uses local Workspace state and calls a provider-neutral Model API when analysis is requested. The workstation does not load model weights in the `review` profile.

| Component | Operating role |
| --- | --- |
| Review workstation | Worklist, image display, clinician decisions, annotations, audit display, and export. |
| RETFound | Five-class DR grade suggestion through `retfound-aptos5`. |
| PRISM-DR | Optional lesion ROI suggestions through `prism-dr-5fold`. |
| Model API | Remote hospital service for the existing inference contracts. |
| CVAT Online | Optional dense annotation and geometry workflow. |

### Safety and interpretation

::: {.callout-warning title="WARNING — model interpretation"}
RETFound and PRISM-DR output is model-assisted evidence. A displayed confidence or score is not a calibrated clinical probability. An empty PRISM result does not prove that lesions are absent.
:::

The final clinician grade, annotation state, and exception decision are human-authored. Original AI evidence remains available in **Models & Audit** and the dataset provenance fields.

### Navigation map

- **Worklist**: admission state, context resolution, exclusions, and case entry.
- **Review**: image-first inspection, optional analysis, overlays, and compact model summaries.
- **Clinician Review**: final DR grade and escalation.
- **Edit Annotations**: human annotation work and optional AI ROI correction/removal.
- **Datasets**: task-specific readiness and export.
- **Models & Audit**: read-only technical provenance.
- **Settings**: Workspace and workstation preferences.
